title: GitHub repo of the week: lemo-opuscar

scenes.say: This GitHub repo makes whole films from pure code.

scenes.label: GitHub stars
scenes.say: Over ten thousand stars, and it is called lemo-opuscar.

scenes.title: What you get
scenes.say: Sixty-six film styles, made with Claude Code and no video model. The code is open source.

scenes.title: How it works
scenes.say: You type an idea, Claude Code draws it, and a film comes out.
Follow iLogix Digital, and DM the word GIT to get the link.
